output.subject: Invoice NPS-0042: vendor set-up documents needed
output.body:
Hello Nova Print Studio team,

Thank you for invoice NPS-0042 for USD 1,277.35. You are not yet set up as a supplier in our system, so before we can process it we need two documents:

1. A completed and signed W-9 for Nova Print Studio LLC.
2. A letter from your bank, on bank letterhead, confirming the account holder name and the account the invoice asks us to pay.

Please upload both through the secure link below; no login is needed. Once we have verified them we will continue with your invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Demo Co.
